A web app for creating playtest decks to print for the trading card game *Sorcery: Contested Realm*. You can import a deck list and check it against your Curiosa collection export to see which cards you own. Cards can be sorted into print buckets, and the app generates print-ready PDF sheets and exports deck lists as text.

The project was a winter break experiment in building an app almost entirely through vibe coding to see what it felt like in a lowstakes environment. The structure: a Flask API with ReportLab/fpdf2 for PDF generation, a React + TypeScript + Tailwind front end, and Vercel for deployment. 

Note: This is a fan-made project, not affiliated with Erik's Curiosa.
